name: knitting-starter-guide
description:
Teaches absolute beginners the essential knitting skills: long-tail cast-on,
knit stitch, purl stitch, bind-off, and basic pattern reading. Includes a
materials checklist, stitch-by-stitch technique descriptions, common mistake
diagnosis, and a first-project recommendation (dishcloth or scarf). Use when
the user wants to learn to knit, asks about casting on, knit and purl
stitches, reading knitting patterns, or choosing a first project. Do NOT use
for crochet techniques, advanced stitch patterns (cables, lace), or sewing
and quilting.
